name: kxwti
title: Will the WTI crude oil front-month daily settlement price be above the strike on the target date?
settlement: Resolves Yes if the daily settlement price of the active NYMEX WTI crude oil futures contract on the target date is above the strike in USD/Bbl. The active contract is the nearest listed month, rolling to the next month 2 business days before the current contract's last trading day. The value is rounded to 2 decimals, and if no data is published the most recent available data is used.
decideContext: Estimate how the news item shifts the WTI front-month futures daily settlement price (USD/Bbl) on the target date, relative to the strike. The market resolves Yes if that settlement is above the strike.
